trait.name: Vehicle
entries: The Autocycle is a vehicle with the Max Creature Capacity of 1 Medium creature and Max Cargo Capacity of 50lb.

trait.name: Empowered Speed
entries: The Autocycle gains additional speed equal to 5 times your INT (minimum of 5 feet).

trait.name: Expert Handling
entries: If you are mounted on the Autocycle, and not incapacitated, you add your PB to any ability check or saving throw the Autocycle is forced to make.

trait.name: Inanimate
entries: The Autocycle is incapacitated without a rider. If it is forced to make an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma ability check or saving throw, its rider is considered to be the target of the effect instead.

trait.name: Jump
entries: If the Autocycle moves at least 30 feet in a straight line, it can clear a distance of up to 60 feet when jumping over a chasm, ravine, or other gap.

trait.name: Mechanical Momentum
entries: If the Autocycle moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hits it with a Ram attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Prone Deficiency
entries: If the Autocycle falls prone, it can't right itself and is incapacitated until a creature uses an action on its turn to stand the Autocycle upright.

trait.name: Swerve
entries: When the Autocycle is upright and is forced to make a Dexterity saving throw, its rider can use their reaction to grant it advantage on its saving throw.

action.name: Ram
entries: {@atk mw} +4 + PB to hit, reach ft., one target you can see. {@h}{@damage 1d10 + 4 + PB} bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Model
entries: The Automaton gains the benefits of one Model detailed at the end of this Specailization.

trait.name: Replaceable parts
entries: When the mending spell is cast on the Automaton, it regains 2d6 hit point

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} + INT + PB to hit, reach ft., one target you can see. {@h}{@damage 1d6+3} bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Arcane Conduit
entries: When your Homunculus is within 120 feet of you, you can cast an Artificer spell with a range of touch through your Homunculus' touch.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the Homunculus makes a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage on a success, and half damage on a failure.

trait.name: Hit Dice
entries: The Homunculus has a total number of d4 Hit Dice equal to your Artificer level. It gains all the normal benefits of both short and long rests.

trait.name: Might of the Master
entries: You add your PB to any ability check or saving throw your Homunculus makes.

action.name: Acidic Spittle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, range 30 ft., one target you can see. {@h}{@damage 2d4 + PB} acid damage.

trait.name: Inanimate
entries: The Rig is incapacitated without its Pilot. When it is forced to make an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma ability check or saving throw, its Pilot is considered to be the target of the effect instead.
Moreover, if the Pilot is concentrating on a spell when the Rig takes damage, the Pilot must make its Constitution saving throw to maintain concentration as if the Pilot had taken that damage.

trait.name: Ironsides
entries: When the Rig takes damage, it reduces the damage by its Constitution modifier (3). Acid and force damage bypass the effects of this feature.

trait.name: Siege Engine
entries: The Rig's weapon attacks and spells deal maximum possible damage, in place of rolling, when used on non-magical objects and structures.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} +4 + PB to hit, reach ft., one target you can see. {@h}{@damage 2d6+4} bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Might of the Master
entries: You can add your PB to any ability check or saving throw that your Steel Defender makes.

trait.name: Hit Dice
entries: Your Steel Defender resembles a Large beast of your choice. Its speed increases by 10 feet (accounted for in the statblock), and it can be ridden as a mount by you as if it was a trained mount.

trait.name: Humanoid
entries: Your Steel Defender is the size of a Medium humanoid creature. It is proficient with shields, and it has humanoid hands that it can use to perform basic tasks.

trait.name: Vigilant
entries: The Steel Defender cannot be surprised.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atk mw} +3 + PB to hit, reach ft., one target you can see. {@h}{@damage 1d8 + 3 + PB} force damage.

action.name: Repair
entries: The Steel Defender can expend one of its Hit Dice to restore {@damage 1d10 + PB} hit points to itself or to one construct or object within 5 feet of it.

trait.name: Inanimate
entries: The Titanic Rig is incapacitated without its Pilot. If it is forced to make an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma ability check or saving throw, its Pilot is considered to be the target of the effect instead.

Moreover, when the Pilot is concentrating on a spell when the Titanic Rig takes damage, the Pilot must make its Constitution saving throw to maintain concentration as if the Pilot had taken that damage.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The Titanic Rig can choose to ignore any spell or effect that would alter or change its form.

trait.name: Ironsides
entries: When the Titanic Rig takes damage, it reduces the damage by its Constitution modifier (4). Acid and force damage bypass the effects of this feature.

trait.name: Siege Engine
entries: The Titanic Rig's weapon attacks and spells deal the maximum possible damage, in place of rolling, when used on non-magical objects and structures.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} +6 + PB to hit, reach ft., one target you can see. {@h}{@damage 3d6+6} bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Titanic Transformation
entries: The Titanic Rig becomes Huge in size, so long as there is room for it to grow. While it is Huge, its Slam attacks deal an additional 1d6 damage on hit, its reach increases by 5 ft., and it adds your INT to all Strength ability checks and saving throws.
This transformation lasts for 1 minute. It ends early if the Titanic Rig is destroyed, or its Pilot uses their action to cause the Rig to revert to its normal form.

The Titanic Rig can transform in this way once, and it regains the ability to do so at the following dawn. When it has no uses left, its Pilot can expend a 5th-level spell slot to use this transformation again.

trait.name: Hit Dice
entries: The Companion has a total number of d8 Hit Dice equal to your Barbarian level. It also gains all of the normal benefits of both short and long rests.

trait.name: Relentless
entries: Once per long rest, when your Companion is reduced to 0 hit points, it can choose to instantly gain hit points equal to your Barbarian level instead of falling to 0.

trait.name: Primal Bond
entries: When your Proficiency Bonus increases at 17th level, this Companion's bonus to its proficient skills and saving throws also increases by the same amount.

trait.name: Savage Charge
entries: If your Companion moves at least 20 ft. in a straight line then hits a target with its Maul attack it deals bonus damage equal to your Exploit Die on hit.

action.name: Maul
entries: {@atk mw} +4 + PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 2d8 + 4 + PB}, and a target equal to the Companion's size (or smaller) is knocked Prone.

monster.name: Living Object
languages: understands the languages of its creator

trait.name: Creator's Bond
entries: You add your PB to any ability check or saving throw that the Living Object makes.

trait.name: Enchanting Touch
entries: Once per turn when the Living Object hits a creature with its Slam, the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or its speed is halved until the start of your next turn as it dances.

trait.name: Lively Dance
entries: If the Living Object makes a Dexterity ability check or saving throw, it gains a bonus to its roll equal to one roll of your Bardic Inspiration Die.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} + CHA + PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On hit: magical bludgeoning damage equal to a roll of your Bardic Inspiration Die + CHA.

trait.name: Hit Dice
entries: Your Loyal Hound has a total number of {@dice d8} Hit Dice equal to your Fighter level. It also gains the normal benefits of both short and long rests.

trait.name: Keen Hearing & Smell
entries: The Hound has advantage on all ability checks that incorporate its hearing or smell.

trait.name: Loyal
entries: While you are within 30 feet of the Hound, it adds your PB to any ability check or saving throw it is forced to make, and it is immune to the {@condition Frightened} condition.

trait.name: Strong Jaws
entries: If the Hound hits a creature equal to its size or smaller with a Bite, it can automatically {@action Grapple} the target in its jaws. While Grappling a creature, it cannot Bite targets other then that creature.

trait.name: Dark Bond
entries: When your Shade is forced to make a saving throw, it uses your saving throw bonus for its roll.

trait.name: Incorporeal Echo
entries: The Shade has no physical presence, but its space counts as {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. It cannot use or interact with objects or magic items.

trait.name: Umbral Guardian
entries: If a creature provokes an {@action opportunity attack} from the Shade, you can use your reaction to make an opportunity attack from the Shade's space.

action.name: Shapechanger
entries: The Familiar can transform into a beast form that resembles a rat (speed 20 ft., climb 20 ft.), a lizard (20 ft., swim 20 ft.) a raven (20 ft., fly 60 ft.), or back to its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form, except for the speed changes. Its equipment is not transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.
